gate.open_confirmatory_holdout_if: aggregate exact-oracle timely-token gain over empirical recovery-first baseline >=5% and positive in all four calibration windows
gate.otherwise: do not materialize the performance holdout; report no material headroom for this trace/mode and continue safety/fault/envelope evaluation

primary_comparison: softwall atomic AI-first order versus event-driven physical recovery-first order, both using the same exact offline weighted selector
scope: Calibration-only structural opportunity screen. Q2 samples and trace windows are excluded from any confirmatory performance confidence interval.
state_mapping_reason: Each 600-epoch independent-node stream supplies its first and last 334 P180 epochs; overlap is 68 calibration states per node and is not treated as an independent confidence sample.
